name: @red-cup-engineering/settle-energy-exchange-service
description: Composes settleEnergyExchangeRecord to settle an EnergyExchangeRecord, refuses as data unless it settles in KWH, and names the exact WitnessedKilowattHour.mint call its unit licenses; lib/contracts/settle-energy-exchange.sol is the on-chain unit ledger that call mints into, never submitted by this operation itself.
